en-US.description: Upload clothing, footwear, and accessory product images to generate model try-on images.
en-US.empty.garments: Upload at least 1 product image first
en-US.extra.placeholder: Describe model traits, scene, tone, or style, e.g. Asian female model, 25 years old, tall, fashion street, warm tone, film look
en-US.label: Virtual Try-On
en-US.upload.garmentTip: Supports tops, coats, pants, skirts, shoes, hats, bags, and more. AI will identify and layer items naturally.
en-US.upload.model: Upload a model image, or let AI create one

zh-CN.description: 上传服饰、鞋靴、配饰等商品图，选择品类，一键生成模特上身穿搭图。
zh-CN.empty.garments: 请先上传至少 1 张商品图
zh-CN.extra.placeholder: 指定模特特征、场景、色调、风格等，例如：亚洲女性模特，25岁，身材高挑，站在时尚街头，暖色调，胶片感
zh-CN.label: 万物上身
zh-CN.upload.garmentTip: 支持上衣、外套、裤子、裙子、鞋靴、帽子、包包等，AI 会自动识别并正确叠穿。
zh-CN.upload.model: 点击上传（不上传则 AI 自动生成模特）
